review.problem: No clear preparatory change is necessary for the stated spool grasp.
review.rationale: The upper flange has a pickup region away from the bench-supported glasses. A vertical initial lift avoids sweeping the neighboring glasses with the lower rim.
review.notes: All three unchanged photographs were visually reviewed; only image 01 is supplied as input. vlm_input.question: Given the image and the task, robot, and status context, what should the human change, if anything, to prevent or resolve problems with this interaction? Return only a JSON object containing an ordered guidance_specs array; use an empty array if no intervention is needed.
vlm_input.task_context: The robot will collect the orange plastic 3D-print scraper and carry it to a nearby tool tray. The spool and glasses will remain on the bench.

guidance_specs.target_object: orange plastic 3D-print scraper lying flat at the front-left of the spool
constraints: Leave enough of the scraper supported on the bench to remain stable while its handle overhangs
guidance_specs.context: Expose the handle over the front bench edge for the opposing-jaw pickup.

review.problem: The 5 mm-thick scraper handle lies flush on the bench without clearance for the lower jaw.
review.rationale: The short slide exposes an underside grasp surface at the bench edge without reorienting the tool or moving nearby objects.
review.notes: All three unchanged photographs were visually reviewed; only image 01 is supplied as input. Task contexts and task-specific grasp capabilities are authored scenario assumptions, not robot logs or measured outcomes. Legacy T002. The collector supplied 10 cm toward the camera on 2026-10-27. Camera-backward denotes that displacement; the 5 mm thickness comes from the original measured dimensions.

vlm_input.task_context: The robot will collect the clear safety glasses beside the spool and carry them to a nearby protective-equipment tray. The spool and scraper will remain on the bench.

Assume the transparent frame has been localized and the claw has suitable tip clearance, opening, reach and controlled closing force.

guidance_specs.target_object: clear safety glasses lying on the bench at the front-right of the spool
constraints: Lift clear of the spool rather than drag the lenses along its cardboard rim
Leave the glasses supported on the bench
guidance_specs.context: Separate the glasses frame from the spool before the claw approaches.

review.problem: One end of the glasses frame touches the spool and restricts the local opposing-jaw approach.
review.rationale: A small rightward relocation separates the frame from the rim and gives the claw room without modifying the spool.
review.notes: All three unchanged photographs were visually reviewed; only image 01 is supplied as input.
